# lane census in the gate image: every target that reached a PASS in EVERY
# census run, with nothing staged. Never edit it — regenerate it:

#         --admit .config/lane-admission/gate.txt

# other name is a `--test` target. `test-lane-contracts` runs exactly this set,
# and `check-lane-contracts` reads it, so a target here that resolves a fixture
# its job does not build is still refused.
